environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL. The function URL resource policy contains a StringEquals condition on 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM' in the function URL configuration (AuthType=AWS_IAM). Callers must present valid SigV4 signatures from IAM principals that have lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission. The resource-based policy on the Lambda function restricts invoke access to principals within the same AWS Organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). Note: the HMAC validation in code has a bug (hmac.new vs hmac.new) and HMAC_SECRET is empty, so application-layer auth is non-functional. The IAM auth is purely at the Lambda Function URL transport layer - AWS rejects requests before they reach the handler code.

config.iam_principals_with_access: only internal service roles with lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission
